description: UI Bridge State Machine page — connect to SDK-integrated apps, discover UI states via automated exploration or manual recording with fingerprint-based co-occurrence analysis, then manage state machine configs across six tabs: Discovery (SDK app connection, explore/record data collection, fingerprint-based state discovery with save), Graph Editor (interactive dagre node-edge layout with element thumbnails and drag-and-drop), State View (list + detail panel via shared StateViewPanel), Transitions (list with action playback via shared TransitionsPanel), Pathfinding (find optimal paths between states via shared PathfindingPanel), and Export (save to JSON file or load into runtime).

groups.name: Page Header and Config Selector
groups.description: The page header shows a Network icon and a dynamic title ('UI Bridge States' when no config is selected, or the active config name). A config selector dropdown (w-220px, placeholder 'Select configuration...') lets users pick an existing config. A Refresh button with RefreshCw icon reloads configs and spins during loading.

assertions.description: The page displays 'UI Bridge States' as the default title when no config is selected, or the active config name when one is loaded
assertions.precondition: No config is selected

assertions.description: Users see a config selector dropdown with a 'Select configuration...' placeholder to choose which state machine config to work with
A Refresh button with RefreshCw icon reloads the config list. The icon spins during loading and the button is disabled while loading.
Selecting a config from the dropdown loads it and updates the page title to the config name. Selecting the empty option clears the active config.
assertions.expected: Selecting a config should: (1) load the config's states and transitions, (2) update the header title to the config name, (3) enable the content tabs to show data, (4) persist the selection to localStorage so it auto-restores on next page load. Selecting the empty 'Select configuration...' option should clear the active config and show empty states in all content tabs.

assertions.description: Clicking Refresh reloads the config list and active config data, showing a spinning RefreshCw icon during the operation
assertions.expected: Clicking Refresh should: (1) spin the RefreshCw icon, (2) disable the button, (3) reload the config list via sm_list_configs, (4) reload the active config data if one is selected, (5) stop spinning and re-enable when complete.

assertions.description: On initial page load, the page auto-selects the last used config (persisted in localStorage) or the most recently created config if no persisted selection exists
assertions.expected: On mount, the page should: (1) load all configs, (2) check localStorage for a persisted config ID, (3) if found and still exists, load that config, (4) otherwise load the most recently created config. The header title should update to the auto-selected config name. If no configs exist, the selector remains on 'Select configuration...'.

groups.name: Tab Navigation Bar
groups.description: Six tabs appear below the header (always visible regardless of config selection): Discovery (Search icon), Graph Editor (GitBranch icon), State View (Layers icon), Transitions (ArrowRightLeft icon), Pathfinding (Route icon), Export (Download icon). The active tab is highlighted with bg-background and shadow-sm. Discovery is the default active tab.

assertions.description: The Discovery tab provides SDK connection and automated/manual state discovery workflows

The Pathfinding tab enables users to find optimal paths between states in the config graph
The Export tab provides JSON file export and runtime loading for state machine configs
Exactly 6 tabs are rendered in the tab bar
